name: Penguin Buffet Restaurant
description: The most popular dining destination at Chimelong Ocean Kingdom — the Penguin Buffet is a spectacular restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the penguin habitat, serving a generous international and Chinese buffet while hundreds of penguins waddle and swim just metres away. An extraordinary dining experience.

items.name: Lunch Buffet
items.description: All-you-can-eat international and Chinese buffet with penguin views

items.name: Dinner Buffet
items.description: Premium evening buffet with extended seafood and Chinese specialities

name: Spaceship Restaurant
description: A dramatic futuristic restaurant housed inside the iconic Spaceship structure at the heart of Chimelong Ocean Kingdom — serving Chinese set meals, dim sum and international dishes in a spectacular sci-fi themed environment with views over the entire park.

items.name: Dim Sum Set
items.description: Selection of freshly steamed Cantonese dim sum with tea

items.name: Chinese Set Meal
items.description: Multi-course Chinese meal with rice, vegetables and protein

items.name: Noodle Soup
items.description: Rich broth noodle soup with choice of protein and seasonal vegetables

name: Seafood Market Restaurant
description: A vibrant seafood market-style restaurant serving the freshest Cantonese and Guangdong-style seafood dishes — guests choose from tanks of live seafood including prawns, crabs, fish and shellfish prepared in traditional Cantonese styles. One of the most authentic dining experiences at Chimelong Ocean Kingdom.

items.name: Steamed Fish
items.description: Whole fresh fish steamed with ginger, spring onion and soy sauce

items.name: Garlic Prawns
items.description: Fresh prawns wok-fried with garlic, chilli and spring onion

items.name: Crab in Black Bean Sauce
items.description: Fresh crab stir-fried in fermented black bean sauce

name: Zhuhai Ocean Buffet
description: A generous Cantonese buffet celebrating the seafood traditions of Zhuhai and the Pearl River Delta — serving freshly prepared dim sum, roasted meats, seafood dishes and traditional Cantonese desserts in a comfortable and relaxed dining room.

items.name: Cantonese Buffet Lunch
items.description: All-you-can-eat Cantonese buffet with dim sum, roasted meats and seafood

items.name: Cantonese Buffet Dinner
items.description: Premium evening Cantonese buffet with extended seafood selection
